title: 2026 Sanriku earthquake — M7.7, 100km ENE of Miyako, Japan
snippet: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck on April 20, 2026 approximately 100 km east-northeast of Miyako, Iwate Prefecture, Japan at a depth of 20 km. Tsunami waves under 1 meter recorded along the Sanriku coast. No satellite-based damage assessment has been published as of May 5. Ground-based reports indicate minor structural damage in coastal communities.
